title: Jesus... Why Did God Create That Tree?

bible.text: But you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, for when you eat from it you will certainly die.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why did God create that tree? The one with the knowledge of good and evil? 🤔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: If God never created that tree... Adam and Eve couldn't have eaten it, right?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The tree wasn't the problem. God gave them a command, and they were free to trust Him or disobey.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So... God gave Adam and Eve a real choice?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: He gave them everything they needed, and He gave them one command.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But God already knew they could disobey...

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Knowing what they could choose is not the same as telling them what to choose.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So the tree itself wasn't evil?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The tree was part of God's creation. The command was not to eat from it.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then the real choice wasn't just about the fruit...

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: It was about whether they would trust God's word and obey His command.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So maybe the deeper question isn't 'Why was the tree there?'... but 'Will I trust God when I have a choice?'

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: If you had a choice today, would you trust God's way? 🤍
